request.goal: run_checks runs five checks in this order (name, required, what its evaluator does): tests_green, required=True, returns status "pass"; lint_clean, required=False, returns status "fail"; files_declared, required=True, raises ValueError("workspace missing"); no_concealed, required=True, returns status "unresolved"; build_ok, required=True, returns status "fail". Give the report's decision, and its failed and unresolved lists as they appear in report.as_dict().

code.title: scripts/postconditions.py excerpt (run_checks)

pass: decision "withhold"; failed = ["build_ok"]; unresolved = ["files_declared", "no_concealed"]. The raising evaluator becomes unresolved, and lint_clean is optional, so its fail is recorded but not listed.
